subject: Apply different themes to individual ggtree facets when using facet_plot

messages.author: 2e965abcb7328238
messages.subject: Apply different themes to individual ggtree facets when using facet_plot
parts:
Hi there,

I really like using ggtree and appreciate that it is very well documented!

Unfortunately, I have been unable find a solution for my following problem:
I am trying to plot different ggplot themes to individual facets when using facet_plot().
Instead of using theme_tree2() to plot a scale below each facet for all facets, I would like to use theme_bw() specifically for two facets containing associated data but keep them_tree2() for the phylogenetic tree.

Is there a way to directly accomplish this using ggtree?

Many thanks in advance for your feedback!

Jan

messages.author: 2a4584b898b0bd00
messages.subject: Re: Apply different themes to individual ggtree facets when using facet_plot
parts: I would recommend you using cowplot or patchwork to create composite plots, see documentation here, https://yulab-smu.github.io/treedata-book/chapter7.html#composite_plot
